LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_Witness_Description: The Zhou royal forces and their opponents are fighting at Lishan. Reach the outer observation area and witness the battle from a safer distance.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_Witness_Objective: Send an awake colonist to the Lishan observation area, maintain unobstructed line of sight to actual battlefield Pawns, and observe for the required time.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_Refugees_Description: Help actual civilian Pawns escape the battlefield, then decide whether to take them in.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_Refugees_Objective: Escort the refugees to the map's escape area. Bring at least half to safety, then choose whether to take them in or let them leave.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_FieldMedical_Description: Treat ordinary wounded soldiers with RimWorld's health system. Protected historical figures are excluded.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_FieldMedical_Objective: Right-click a downed ordinary soldier and choose Tend; complete treatment on at least two soldiers.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_RoyalRecords_Description: Recover and preserve a representative bundle of royal records. This gameplay item does not represent a known excavated document.
LanguageData.HE001_SideQuest_RoyalRecords_Objective: Haul the actual records item into a building or a colonist's carried inventory.
LanguageData.HE001_BattleDangerWarning: Intense fighting is taking place near Lishan. Your people can continue, but they may be struck by stray attacks or encounter enemy forces.
LanguageData.HE001_AdoptRefugeesPrompt: The refugees have reached safety. Would you like them to join your colony or leave on their own?
LanguageData.HE001_CoreConstructionRestricted: Building is restricted within the royal retreat route and historical core during the battle.
LanguageData.HE001_RoyalRecordBundle_Description: A gameplay item representing records that might be recovered during the crisis; it is not a specific archaeological find.
LanguageData.HE001_WitnessArchive_Title: Eyewitness account of the Lishan Crisis
LanguageData.HE001_WitnessArchive_Description: A colonist returned from Lishan and preserved an account of what they personally observed. Details are limited to the stages and evidence recorded for this witness.
LanguageData.HE001_RoyalDocumentArchive_Description: A game-fictional royal document was secured as contemporary-document evidence. It is not presented as an authentic archaeological find.
